name: Cynthia/Adele/Martha
original_name: シンシア・アデーレ・マーサ
source:
Cynthia Whitford (Middle)
18 years old, Wind attribute.
Self proclaimed leader of Julius's fanclub. 

Adele Mason (Right)
18 years old, Fire attribute.
Cynthia's right hand woman.

Martha Alcott (Left) 
18 years old, Water attribute.
She doesn't really care about anything but sweets.
